description: This course prepares students to understand and lead the application of agentic AI in modern business analytics. It focuses on how organizations can leverage intelligent AI agents to enhance decision-making, automate analytical processes, and unlock new sources of business value. Students will learn frameworks for identifying high-impact opportunities, redesigning workflows, and evaluating the strategic and financial implications of AI adoption. Students will gain experience in translating business challenges into actionable AI concepts, assessing return on investment, and managing ethical and governance considerations. The course develops both the analytical fluency and leadership capability required to guide AI-enabled transformation in business environments.
prerequisiteAdvisory: Basic knowledge in Python or equivalent analytics platforms (e.g., BI tools, R, or no-code AI tools) is recommended.
title: AI Agents for Business Analytics
